column1: # What we shipped, and when. Read alongside trend.py, which prints these
# between the runs they fall between.
# This file is the reason the panel is worth more than the one-shot before/after
# it replaces. A single 14 Sep -> 13 Oct comparison has no control and no
# attribution: every channel moves at once and the model versions move underneath
# it. A dated series with the ship dates written on it lets a reader see which
# change a movement follows — and lets them see when it follows nothing.
# Add the row ON THE DAY. A date reconstructed from memory a fortnight later is
# the thing this file exists to stop.
# status: shipped = live and crawlable | planned = dated, not yet out
# surface: measurement | github | hn | reddit | linkedin | listing | site
